digest.title: Claude users found ways around safeguards for bioweapons research
digest.tldr: Some dangerous biology looks much like legitimate research, complicating AI safeguards.

digest.title: Claude Used to Automate Exploitation and Data Theft Across Multiple Victims
digest.tldr: Anthropic has warned that cybercriminals and state-sponsored hackers alike are using its Claude models for cyber attacks, weapons design, propaganda, and mass surveillance between December 2025 and August 2026.

digest.title: Russian State-Sponsored Hackers Use Claude to Rebuild Malware After Detection
digest.tldr: Anthropic on Thursday revealed it disrupted a campaign mounted by a Russian state-sponsored threat actor that abused Claude for developing an AI-assisted workflow to get ahead of the detection curve.
